description: Film the scenario and edit the video. Returns the MP4 path and the storyboard (one image per step): look at it and fix framing, bubbles or data before handing the video over. Takes about the length of the video plus a few seconds per 10 seconds of video. It really performs the steps in the app (a click on Send sends, a click on Delete deletes): use a demo account or a staging environment.

noVoice.description: Skip the voice-over even if the scenario enables it.

path.description: Path of the scenario JSON file. Prefer an absolute path; a relative one is resolved from the server's working directory.

scenario.description: Optional scenario object: validated, then written to `path` (overwriting that file), then used.

name: screenplay_record
title: Film and edit a scenario
